reason: Alert 1 (sql-injection) is alert-TP. There is no sanitization or parameterized query usage. The resolved sink value for 'q' is 'UPDATE accounts SET note='' + <user_input> + '' WHERE id=1', which allows arbitrary SQL manipulation even though execution is deferred to a later stage.
